title: Legacy Security Skeleton
kicker: a rusted dead guard still obeying a security routine nobody living remembers
hook: a rusted dead guard still obeying a security routine nobody living remembers

blocks.label: Public Read
blocks.body: A rusted skeleton guard in chain scraps and bead charms stands with a cracked skull, old badge fragments, and road-dust still clinging to the bones.

blocks.label: Comes Across As
blocks.body: Not malice, momentum. A duty that outlived the man and a debt that kept the bones. Somewhere under the patrol loop is someone who wants, very quietly, for the post to finally fall.

blocks.label: Might Offer
blocks.body: A fight A mercy/release angle A clue that old contracts can outlive bodies
